title: KET 听力训练(原创文本, Web Speech 朗读)

questions.script: Boy: What time does the film start, Mum? Woman: At half past four, so we must leave home at four.
questions.q: What time does the film start?
questions.explain: half past four = 4:30；4 点是出门时间。

questions.script: Girl: Did you buy apples, Dad? Man: They had no good apples, so I got bananas and some grapes instead.
questions.explain: 没买苹果，买了香蕉和葡萄。

questions.script: Woman: How did you get to school today, Ben? The buses weren't running. Boy: Dad wanted to drive me, but I rode my bike.
questions.q: How did Ben get to school?

questions.script: Boy: Is your violin lesson on Tuesday? Girl: It was, but my teacher moved it to Thursday this term.
questions.q: When is the girl's violin lesson now?

questions.script: Man: The pet shop has rabbits and birds. Girl: I know, but I want a fish, Dad. A little orange one!
questions.q: Which pet does the girl want?

parts.name: Part 2 · 听独白填空（拼写要对）
parts.script: Hello everyone! Here is the information about our school trip to the city zoo. We will go on Friday, the twelfth of May. The bus leaves at eight fifteen, so please don't be late. A ticket costs six pounds fifty. Bring a hat because it will be sunny. If you have questions, call Miss Green on 07700 900 312.

questions.q: 笔记：Trip day: Friday, the ___ of May（写数字，如 12）

questions.explain: Bring a hat because it will be sunny。拼写 h-a-t。

questions.script: Girl: Hi Sam! Was the maths test hard? Boy: Not really. The English one last week was much harder. Girl: Really? I loved that one!
questions.q: What does Sam think about the maths test?

questions.script: Boy: Are you coming to football practice? Girl: I can't. My grandma is arriving from the airport and we're making a big dinner for her.
questions.q: Why can't the girl go to practice?

questions.script: Woman: Would you like chicken or fish, dear? Boy: Hmm, I had fish yesterday... chicken please, with rice not chips.
Girl: Your new schoolbag is cool! Was it expensive? Boy: The blue ones were thirty pounds, but mine was twenty because it's green — nobody wanted green!
questions.q: How much was the boy's bag?

questions.script: Boy: Shall we do our project on pandas? Girl: Everyone does pandas! Let's choose whales — they sing, you know. Boy: OK, you win.
questions.q: What will they do their project about?
questions.explain: Let's choose whales… OK, you win。

questions.script: Attention shoppers! Today only, all children's books on the second floor are half price. The children's floor closes at seven tonight.
questions.explain: shoppers + half price → 书店促销广播。

questions.script: Boy: And then the little dragon found his fire! The end. Girl: Read it again! Boy: Again?! That was the third time!
options: Reading a story to a child
questions.explain: 给小孩读故事，都读第三遍了。

questions.script: Woman: Remember: warm up first, drink water often, and stop if your legs hurt. See you all at the race on Sunday!
questions.explain: 热身、喝水、周日比赛 → 教练。

questions.script: Man: Good morning! Single to Green Park? That's two pounds. The next one leaves from stop C in five minutes.
Girl: Mum, I can't find my music book anywhere, and my lesson is in half an hour! Woman: Did you look under your bed? Girl: ...Found it!

parts.name: Part 5 · 匹配（听人物与物品）
parts.script: Listen to Anna telling her mum what her friends want to drink at her party. Ben wants apple juice — he drinks it every day. Carla asked for milk, warm milk! Dan said just water, he is very sporty. Emma would like orange juice. And Fred wants lemonade — but only if it's cold!

questions.script: Woman: Does the football club meet on Monday? Boy: It did last year. Now it's Wednesday, right after school.
questions.q: When does the football club meet now?

questions.script: Girl: I'd like a sandwich, please. Man: Cheese or chicken? Girl: Cheese please — oh wait, egg! Egg, please.
questions.q: Which sandwich does the girl buy?

questions.script: Boy: Wow, is that your new violin? Girl: It's my sister's. Mine is the small brown one by the piano.
questions.explain: Mine is the small brown one。

questions.script: Man: The weather says rain in the morning, but sunny for your picnic after lunch. Girl: Perfect!
questions.q: What will the weather be like at picnic time?

questions.script: Woman: Your room, Jake! Boy: I cleaned the desk and the floor, Mum. Woman: And the clothes on the chair? Boy: ...Doing it now.
questions.explain: 桌子地板已打扫，剩椅子上的衣服。

parts.name: Part 2 · 听独白填空（拼写要对）
parts.script: Welcome to the Star Swimming Pool! Here is our new information. The pool opens every day at nine, but on Sundays we open at ten. A children's ticket is now three pounds twenty. Our new teacher is called Mr Reed — that's R-E-E-D. He teaches beginners on Tuesday afternoons at five o'clock. Don't forget to bring a towel!

questions.q: 笔记：On Sundays the pool opens at ___（写数字）
questions.explain: on Sundays we open at ten。

questions.q: 笔记：New teacher's name: Mr ___（听拼读）

questions.explain: Tuesday afternoons，注意 Tuesday 拼写。

questions.script: Boy: How was the school play? Girl: The story was a bit boring, but the music was wonderful — I want the songs on my phone!
questions.q: What did the girl like about the play?

questions.script: Girl: Are you still reading that space book? Boy: I finished it in two days! Now I'm on a book about the sea. It's even better.
questions.q: What is the boy reading now?
questions.explain: now I'm on a book about the sea。

questions.script: Woman: Tickets, please. Boy: Two children to Mill Road... Oh no, I left my money in my other coat! Woman: You can pay me on the way back, I know your mum.
options: He is on the wrong bus.
questions.explain: left my money in my other coat。

questions.script: Boy: Let's meet at three to practise our song. Girl: My piano lesson finishes at three thirty. Four o'clock at my house? Boy: See you then!
questions.explain: Four o'clock at my house? See you then!

questions.script: Girl: Dad, can Milo sleep in my room tonight? Man: The cat sleeps in the kitchen, you know that. Girl: But it's cold! Man: ...One night. Only one!
questions.q: Where will the cat sleep tonight?
questions.explain: 爸爸最后松口 One night → 睡女孩房间。

questions.script: Man: Please open your books at page forty. Today we're learning about rivers. Ana, can you read the first line for us?
questions.explain: 翻书、点名朗读 → 课堂。

questions.script: Girl: I water it every morning, and look — the first tomato! It's tiny and green, but it's mine!
questions.q: What is the girl talking about?
questions.explain: 每天浇水长出第一个番茄 → 植物。

questions.script: Woman: The number seven is late again! I've waited twenty minutes. I'll walk — it's only two stops.
Boy: First you need two eggs. Mix them with the milk — slowly! Then a little sugar. My grandma taught me this.
questions.explain: 鸡蛋牛奶糖 → 教做食物。

questions.script: Man: Quiet everyone... three, two, one... Happy birthday, Maya! Come in! Girl: Oh!! You were all hiding!
questions.q: What kind of party is it?
questions.explain: 大家藏起来 → 惊喜派对。

parts.name: Part 5 · 匹配（听人物与地点）
parts.script: Mr Kim is telling the class where everyone will help on Open Day. Paul, you are strong — you will help in the gym. Rosa, you speak clearly, so you will stand at the front door and say hello. Tim, you will show visitors the art room, since your pictures are on the wall there. Amy, the library needs a quiet helper — that's you. And Leo, you will help in the music room. You can play something!

questions.explain: 说话清楚 → 门口迎宾。
图书馆需要安静的帮手。

questions.script: Girl: Did you see my glasses? Not the reading ones — my sunglasses. Boy: On your head, sis. Girl: ...Don't laugh!
Man: The doctor can see you at nine tomorrow. Woman: I take my son to school then. Anything later? Man: Eleven thirty? Woman: Perfect.
questions.q: What time is the woman's doctor visit?

questions.script: Boy: Three tickets please — my parents and me. Woman: Children pay half, so that's two adults and one half... twenty-five pounds.
questions.q: How many people are going in?

questions.script: Girl: I wanted the red trainers but they only had size thirty-eight. Woman: And? Girl: I got the same ones in white. They had my size.
questions.q: Which trainers did the girl buy?

questions.script: Boy: It says cloudy for the match tomorrow. Girl: Better than last week! We played in the rain and I couldn't see the ball.
questions.q: What was the weather at last week's match?

parts.name: Part 2 · 听独白填空（拼写要对）
parts.script: Hi, this is a message for Katya about Saturday's orchestra day. We will practise in the Town Hall, not at school. Please arrive at nine forty-five. Bring your music stand and a pencil for writing notes. Lunch is free, but bring two pounds for the afternoon drink. My new phone number is 07700 900 578. See you Saturday!

questions.explain: Town Hall 市政厅，不在学校。

questions.q: 笔记：Bring: music stand and a ___
笔记：Bring £ ___ for a drink（写数字）
questions.explain: two pounds for the afternoon drink；午餐免费。

questions.script: Boy: Can we watch the football at seven? Girl: My cooking show is at seven! Boy: Your show repeats at ten... Girl: Fine. But you owe me.
questions.q: What will they watch at seven?
questions.explain: 女孩让步，因为她的节目十点重播。

questions.script: Woman: How's the new flat, Leo? Boy: My room is smaller, but I can see the whole park from my window. I don't miss the old one at all.
questions.q: How does Leo feel about the new flat?
options: He likes it because of the view.
questions.explain: 房间小但能看到公园，一点不想念旧家。

questions.script: Girl: Did you finish the story for homework? Boy: Almost. I wrote the beginning and the middle, but I can't think of a good end. Girl: Make the dog the hero! Boy: ...That's actually great.
questions.q: What part of the story is difficult for the boy?
questions.explain: can't think of a good end。

questions.script: Boy: Mum, the class trip costs fifteen pounds. Woman: Didn't the letter say twelve? Boy: That was without the museum. Everyone's doing the museum. Woman: All right, fifteen.
questions.q: How much will the mum pay?

questions.script: Girl: You look tired. Boy: I got up at five to watch the tennis from Australia. Girl: Was it good? Boy: I fell asleep in the second game!
questions.explain: got up at five 看澳网直播。

questions.script: Woman: This one is two hundred years old. Please don't touch the glass, children — but you can draw it if you like! Picture paper is by the door.
questions.explain: 200 年历史+别碰玻璃 → 博物馆讲解员。

questions.script: Boy: The strings were too high at first, and my fingers hurt every day. Now, after a year, I can play three whole songs — it was worth it.
questions.q: What is the boy talking about?
questions.explain: 琴弦、手指疼、能弹三首曲子 → 学乐器。

questions.script: Woman: Don't put so much water on it! Little and often, that's the way. And move it near the window — it wants light, not shadow.
options: How to care for a plant
questions.explain: 少量多次浇水+要光照 → 养植物。

questions.script: Man: Platform two, not platform five — they changed it a minute ago. Run, you have three minutes! The next one is in two hours.
questions.explain: 站台改到 2 号，只剩 3 分钟。

questions.script: Girl: I did all the easy questions first, then went back to the hard ones. I checked my spelling twice. I think... I think it went well!
questions.q: What is the girl talking about?
questions.explain: 先易后难+检查拼写 → 刚考完试。

parts.name: Part 5 · 匹配（听人物与礼物）
parts.script: Grandma is telling Grandpa what she bought for the grandchildren. For little Anya, I got the picture book about the moon. Boris gets the blue football — his old one is flat. For Clara, the paint box, because she draws all day. Dima asked for the game of chess, imagine that! And for baby Elsa, the soft toy rabbit, of course.

questions.explain: the picture book about the moon。
the paint box，因为她整天画画。
